host_state: RTX 3060 Laptop pinned at SM 900 MHz (SW thermal slowdown active during the whole session), P3, 57-65 C; non-quiescent desktop (Discord, WebView2, VS Code resident)

cold_start.note: catalog.configure includes Core discovery, catalog validation and mind spin-up; matches the documented 5.15s catalog-ready figure. First P of a fresh server pays full prefill: 1356 tokens at 855 tok/s = 1.585s (turn_retry_decomposition_full_b).

concurrency_owned_server_64tok_decodes.reading: three slots overlap at ~2.05x effective throughput; +46% per-request latency under full contention; a fourth request queues bounded (~one decode) and never fails

cancellation.method: client socket close 0.5s into a 512-token decode, then a fresh 16-token probe

transport.reading: the entire non-LLM pipeline (JSONL over pipes, routing, explicit resolution) costs 1-2 ms; BAXY's full chat path adds ~0.2 ms p50 over a bare POST on the pooled connection
transport.dotnet_app_side: characterized by the promoted microbenchmarks (writer 7.0ms/20k, reader 18.2ms, fingerprint 365ms/50k) re-validated green in today's Full gate; WPF/WebView2 paint time requires an interactive UI session and stays an explicit boundary

soak_4_consecutive_full_runs.tail_source: exclusively the known drain-retry cases (turn-23 4/4, turn-06 2/4, turn-04 2/4), consistent with the 30-run corpus frequencies

resources.leak: none observed; VRAM returns per restart cycle

visible_response_boundary: the protocol does not stream tokens; the visible reply equals the decide result plus narrate/compose (p50 0.19-0.25s documented) plus App/WebView paint (out of scope without an interactive session). TTFT for chat was measured as a server-timing proxy in equivalent_overhead_ab_20260730.json.
thermal_comparability_note: every measurement today ran at the same driver-pinned 900 MHz SM clock; the difference against the early 2026-07-30 product run (p50 4.89/p95 15.9) is host noise and cache state, not clock speed.
